verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an automation platform like Zapier, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no batch or bulk-processing capability for acting on many items at once. The '9,000+ apps' claims are about breadth of app coverage, single actions (including stored actions) run one call at a time, and the community report of thousands of duplicate invites describes a misconfigured Zap, not a documented bulk feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
